body:
## Summary
- Chat, Rich chat content and Theme gradients & fonts leave Experimental for v1.0.0. Each is on unless saved `false`, in every build, read through `isGraduatedFlagOn` (`src/shared/graduated-flags.ts`, identical to the sibling PR's copy).
- The terminal stays first-class. The per-provider Chat/CLI choice, the per-agent override and every fallback are unchanged, and the Copilot SDK driver keeps its own flag, still preview-only.
- Existing users whose agents now open in chat get a one-time toast linking to Settings > Agents & providers.

## What happens on upgrade
| Saved state | Result |
|---|---|
| New install, nothing saved | Chat, rich content and theme fonts/gradients on. No toast, including after it gets agents. |
| Stable user: no `chat` key, no saved choice, has durable agents | Agents open in chat. One toast. |
| 0.41 user with `structuredMode` | As above. The existing structured-mode notice now says those agents open in Chat or the CLI view, as set in Settings, because "CLI view" stopped being true. |
| Beta user with `chat: true` | Unchanged. No toast. |
| Stable user who saved `chat: true` on an earlier beta | Now honoured: chat. Before, stable ignored it. |
| Saved `chat: false` | Terminal for every agent, including one saved on Chat. No toast. Provider and agent choices are kept and apply again if Chat goes back on. |
| Saved `richChatContent: false` or `themeGradients: false` | Off, in main, renderer and Annex. |
| Any saved provider or agent choice | Respected. No toast. |
| `experimental-settings.json` can't be read | Chat and rich content read as off, in main, the renderer and Annex, since a saved `false` may be in that file. Theme fonts and gradients stay on, since that's only cosmetic. They come back once the file is readable. |

Nothing saved is rewritten, except that `annex`, `clubhouseMcp` and `review` are dropped from experimental settings through the existing stale-flag cleanup. A search found nothing that reads them.

**Rich chat content and Annex.** On upgrade, a phone already paired (Clubhouse Go) with an Annex server that's already on can read any file the desktop user can read, with size caps, with no new action from the user. Before this it needed the opt-in, which stable builds didn't honour. Broad file access (#2478) is unchanged, neither widened nor narrowed. The **Rich chat content** toggle and the help (Agent providers, Annex) both say this, and turning the toggle off stops it.

**Themes.** No built-in theme defines fonts or gradients, so built-ins keep their look, with one exception: terminals in the **Terminal** theme now use its font override, which that code path only applied with the flag on. Plugin themes now show their fonts and gradients, and the plugin API exposes them by default. The default theme is unchanged.

**The Dispatcher.** It's saved with `runtimeMode: 'chat'`, so with this PR it runs in chat with Preview off too. Saved `chat: false` puts it in the terminal, and the Chat view toggle brings it back. Nothing starts it on its own, and it's in no project, so it never counts toward the first-launch toast.

## The way back on
**Chat view** is one always-visible toggle in a new **Chat** section on Settings > Agents & providers, next to **Rich chat content**. It's the smallest honest option: one field with no state that appears and disappears, and it says what it overrides. Turning it on applies at once, since panes re-read the flag. Turning it off applies per wake, so a running chat keeps its view until it sleeps, as the help text says. With it off, no agent is offered a Chat switch, and a window opened afterwards still shows an agent that's live in chat.

**Failed saves.** If saving **Chat view**, **Rich chat content** or **Theme gradients & fonts** fails, the switch goes back to what's saved and the page says "Couldn't save that setting, so it wasn't changed. Try again." This is the same text #2824 adds to the Experimental page. A failed theme save also re-applies the theme, and the panes' cached flags are only reset once a save succeeds.

## First-launch toast contract (#2814)
- **Marker:** `chatMessageShown`, in renderer `localStorage`, set when the toast shows. It means "the user has been told about chat". `introSeen` isn't read or added.
- **For the intro:** `markChatMessageShown()` in `src/renderer/features/agents/chat/chat-default-tip.ts`. An intro calls it when it actually shows the chat step, which suppresses the toast. An intro skipped before that step doesn't, so the toast still shows once.
- **Call site:** the single `showChatDefaultTip()` call in `initAppEventBridge` (`src/renderer/app-event-bridge.ts`), which #2814 can move or gate.
- **Ruling out:** `clubhouse_chat_default_tip` separately remembers "this user doesn't need telling" (saved choice, or no agent that would open in chat), so a new install isn't told later. It's the key the old tip used, so anyone who already saw that tip isn't told again.

The toast replaces `ChatDefaultTip`, the popover under the Chat/CLI switch, which would otherwise have doubled up and shown to new installs. `Toast` gains an optional action.

## Other changes
- Settings: Experimental loses the three entries. Display & UI gains **Theme gradients & fonts**, applied at once with no restart, and plugin `onDidChange` fires when it changes. `experimentalGradients` keeps its name, since renaming touches about ten production sites and conflicts with the sibling PR.
- Flash prevention: `src/renderer/index.html` restores font and gradient classes only from cached variables, and `applyTheme` caches those only with the feature on. A saved `false` has nothing to flash, and turning it off rewrites the cache at once. An upgrader with a plugin theme sees its fonts and gradients appear once, when the theme loads on first launch.
- Manifest validator: its checks still hold, since it only type-checks strings. Comments and plugin type docs no longer say the fields need an experimental flag.
- Docs and help updated: agents, providers, Annex, themes, `settings-read-mcp.md`, `mobile-phone-content.md`, `copilot-sdk-driver.md`, and the status line in `chat-e2e-plan.md`.

## Test Plan
- [x] `npm run typecheck`: passes on the pushed commit. `npm run lint`: 0 errors. tsc, webpack and Playwright resolve this worktree's own `node_modules` (`npm ci` here).
- [x] Unit coverage: gates in every build, saved false, agent override, toggles, toast eligibility and once-only, marker, stale flags, theme setting, plugin API.
- [x] CI: Validate passes on 07ea8b891, first attempt (run 41998380191), with main at 17ac7ab8a merged and the review fixes. macOS build + E2E smoke, Linux Package Smoke Test and Dependency resolution preflight were skipped by the run plan.
- [x] Local full `npm test` on 07ea8b891, with the default reporter: exit 0, 22,492 passed, 0 failed, 97 skipped, no unhandled errors. Typecheck passes.

**New E2E** in `stable-mode.spec.ts` (Linux and Windows only, its own job, so no macOS minutes and no long-pole change; five more launches): fresh install, upgrades from 0.42 and 0.41, saved agent override, saved false stays terminal, turning a saved false back on from Settings, and a real Dispatcher wake into chat with Preview off, on a fake CLI. The beta profile is covered in the existing round trip. 0.41 gets its own seed because `git show v0.41.0` has a different saved shape: the `structuredMode` flag and a per-agent field. The chat-rich and chat-fake-cli specs now run on the default rather than seeding flags. `start-agent`, `popout-window` and `agent-real-cli` save `chat: false`, since they test the CLI view.

## Unverified
- **Earlier local exit 1, resolved.** A local run on c0d56d91d exited 1 with 0 failed tests, because the JSON-only reporter it used hid 35 unhandled `chat.statPaths is not a function` rejections. CI's default reporter showed them on that commit. Rich content on by default reaches file chips, and the shared test mock had no `statPaths`. With the stub in `test/setup-renderer.ts`, the same 21,802 tests pass with exit 0.
- **No E2E has run locally**, by project rule. CI is the only E2E check. All E2E jobs, including the new stable-mode specs, pass on 2aa0ed9a6.
- **No visual check** of the new toggles, the toast, or a gradient plugin theme.
- **Pop-outs:** an open pop-out reads Chat view once, so it picks up a change when reopened.
- **Stable candidate:** expectations in `stable-candidate-lib.mjs` are updated and unit-tested, but the dispatch-only job hasn't run against a packaged build.
- **Graduation gate:** the gate in `docs/testing/chat-e2e-plan.md` isn't complete. The default flipped for v1.0.0 and the doc now says what counts toward the gate from here. It's a clarification, not a waiver, and it's the maintainer's call.

title: Graduate Chat, Rich chat content and Theme gradients & fonts for v1.0.0
